t: Natural Fun - DeepFUN
s: August 3, 2014 - When I think about how deeply I was struck by the importance of what Magdalena Cabrera was doing with her Leaping Lizards Preschool – a preschool without walls, where kids spend almost every day playing in some natural setting; or how impressed I’ve been with the accomplishments of organizations like the Natural Playgrounds Company, who design and build playgrounds that incorporate rocks and plants and trees and hills; or the endless ingenuity of folk toys made from natural things like plants and pebbles; or how completely gifted I felt when my daughter and her family treated us to a night’s lodging at McCormick’s Creek State Park…. I guess that’s how it is with finding fun – you have to find it over and over again before you realize how deeply fun it is, how central it is to your happiness.
